description: A high-quaity stereo recording of gentle waves at the balic sea near Wustrow. This track captures the rythmic, soothing sound of the waves lapping against the sandy shore. Details: Clear transients of water hitting the sand and receding over smal stones. Equipment: Recorded with a Tascam DR-05 for a Natural an wide stereo image.Perfect for background ambiance and cinematic foley. Feel free to use this sound in your projects!
